doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Akshitha did her MBBS from the esteemed B.J Medical College, Pune. After completing her DNB General Surgery, she did 2 years HBNI fellowship in Breast Surgical Oncology from Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. She has done MRCS (Ed) from prestigious The Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh. Apart from this, she is also actively involved in Basic & Translational Research Laboratory & Clinician Scientist Laboratory over the few years.She has presented and published several research articles and abstracts at various national and international conferences and journals.
